source='''from collections import deque\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    seen = set()\n    largest_color, largest_size = 0, 0\n    for r in range(rows):\n        for c in range(cols):\n            color = grid[r][c]\n            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:\n                continue\n            queue = deque([(r, c)])\n            seen.add((r, c))\n            size = 0\n            while queue:\n                y, x = queue.popleft()\n                size += 1\n                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):\n                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx\n                    if (0 <= ny < rows and 0 <= nx < cols and\n                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):\n                        seen.add((ny, nx))\n                        queue.append((ny, nx))\n            if size > largest_size:\n                largest_color, largest_size = color, size\n    return [[largest_color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]\n'''
